source: query-phrasing workflow, run 44815503717 (DataForSEO, DE market, de)
method: Each text names the observed phrasings it follows. 'observed': people type that form; 'adapted': the form is observed but reworded so the slot works for any noun of any gender, singular, with the words that agree with it written as {masculine|feminine|neuter} groups; 'unsupported': no query in the data. Search data is lowercase; the texts use standard German spelling.
